description: This script manages DNS bootstrap registration, including removing old and local DNS registrations, and starting/stopping services based on system events and network status. It handles IPv4 and IPv6 address registration with system events and dynamically generates a script to ensure DNS registration is successful.

methods.name: remove_old_registrations
methods.description: Removes DNS registrations for a given DNS name from a remote system event namespace.

methods.name: remove_local_registrations
methods.description: Removes DNS registrations for a given DNS name from local system event namespace.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting up variables and script file path.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the DNS bootstrap service, registering addresses and creating a script to verify DNS registration.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the DNS bootstrap service, removing DNS registrations and restarting DNS.
